mapper.select: select recipient_history_id, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_address, province_code, city_code, district_code, amap_city_code, province_name, city_name, district_name, parse_status, parse_message, used from ry_business.ry_rental_order_recipient_history where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and order_no = #{orderNo} and is_delete = 0 and used = 1 order by create_time desc, recipient_history_id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_order_recipient_history (tenant_id, member_id, order_id, order_no, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_address, province_code, city_code, district_code, amap_city_code, province_name, city_name, district_name, parse_status, parse_message, used, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{record.contactName}, #{record.contactPhone}, #{record.contactAddress}, #{record.provinceCode}, #{record.cityCode}, #{record.districtCode}, #{record.amapCityCode}, #{record.provinceName}, #{record.cityName}, #{record.districtName}, coalesce(#{record.parseStatus}, 'failed'), #{record.parseMessage}, 1, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
